in_sanskrit.name: Varshan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rain, Monsoon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Varshan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Varshan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vrshabha', which means rain or monsoon. It is a name that symbolizes growth, success, and prosperity. The name is believed to bring blessings of good rain and a bountiful harvest.
